items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: In fact I played a couple of jobs with him on the bass fiddle, you know

ctx.x: Did you have any real idols when you were beginning to play? I mean, anybody that you admired, any trombonists? Like you listened to on a record or an impression, either one?
Well, T. Gordon, you know, everybody liked him. Everybody liked T. Gordon. Do you remember George Brunis? George Brunis?
Do you remember George Brunis? Oh yeah, I remember George, yeah. George. Well, George with Ted Lewis.
